about

Second Draft is the web studio of Ma'amo Koba, a composer and producer working from the Grey Highlands of Ontario, in English and French.

He came to web work the way most of our clients do: he needed sites for his own studio, a record label and a breathwork school, and wanted off the monthly builders. Building them with AI, he learned where it shines, where it quietly breaks, and that the last stretch is where a site is won or lost.

A producer's habits carry over well. Listen to what you're making, cut what doesn't serve it, finish it properly, and ship.

questions

Do I own the site?
Yes. The code, the domain and the hosting account are in your name from the start. If you ever want to leave us, there's nothing to untangle.
Do you use AI?
Yes, for speed. Every line is then reviewed, tested on real phones and browsers, and finished by a person. That's the difference you're paying for.
I started on Lovable, Bolt, v0, Framer or Squarespace. Can you work with it?
Usually, yes. Send the link or the export. The check-up tells you honestly whether to fix what you have or rebuild it.
How fast is fast?
Launch pages in about a week, studio sites in two to three weeks, rescues often in a few days. The quote gives you a date.
What will it cost to keep running?
For most sites, just the domain: about $20–$30 a year. Hosting on Cloudflare Pages or Vercel is free at this size. The care plan is optional.
Can the site be in French?
Yes. Sites in English, French or both, written by a native speaker. The second language is a 30% add-on.
How do payments work?
Half when you approve the quote, half at launch. Calls and check-ups are paid when booked. Care plans run month to month.
